sources.cite: TensorFlow, 'Get started with TensorFlow Data Validation' (training-serving skew)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: skew between training and serving data is detected with a skew_comparator on the schema and validate_statistics(statistics=train_stats, schema=schema, serving_statistics=serving_stats); 'L-infinity norm will only detect skew for the categorical features ... specifying a jensen_shannon_divergence threshold ... would detect skew for both numeric and categorical features'; if skew is real 'further investigation is necessary as this could have a direct impact on model performance'. The platform's Model Monitoring alert text is the author's scenario (to verify against the Model Monitoring documentation).
